biography.characterFamilySituation: Estranged from family, one younger sister in Bellevue
biography.description: Lean and wiry elf with sharp features and a perpetual half-smile. Her violet eyes seem to track movement faster than normal. She favors armored jackets with too many pockets and moves with the fluid grace of someone whose body has been honed into a weapon by magic.
biography.background: Born in the Redmond Barrens, Kira's magical aptitude manifested early as physical enhancement rather than spellcasting. She trained under a secretive sensei who taught her to channel mana through her body, enhancing reflexes, perception, and combat ability. A physical adept who blurs the line between mundane and magical, she runs the shadows to fund her sister's education and satisfy her thrill-seeking nature.

system.description: The most popular heavy pistol in the world, especially among mercenaries and shadowrunners.
A traditional Japanese sword, perfectly balanced for swift, lethal strikes. Nightwire's weapon of choice.
A sturdy combat knife, the runner's best friend.
The most popular armor on the streets, available in every style imaginable.
Increases the adept's reaction speed, similar to wired reflexes.
The adept can deal Physical damage with unarmed attacks.
system.gameEffect: Unarmed attacks deal Physical damage instead of Stun. Can choose Physical or Stun at the time of attack.

system.description: The adept's strikes with a specific melee weapon skill are more damaging.
system.gameEffect: +1 DV to Blades attacks per rating.

system.description: The adept has a preternatural awareness of threats.
system.gameEffect: +1 dice to defense tests and +1 to surprise tests per rating.

system.description: The adept's body is toughened against damage through mystical means.
The adept's senses are magically enhanced.
system.gameEffect: +1 to Perception and Assensing tests per rating.

system.description: The adept can run along vertical surfaces for short distances.
system.gameEffect: Allows running along vertical surfaces for a number of meters equal to running distance.

system.description: +2 dice pool modifier to Logic-based tests involving pattern recognition, evidence analysis, or puzzle solving.
When using Full Defense, the character may use Agility in place of Willpower.
The character has a national SIN, subject to taxation and tracking.
A katana enchanted as a weapon focus, bonded to Nightwire.
system.gameEffect: Adds Force as dice pool bonus to melee attacks. Can damage spirits and astral entities.

system.description: A small jade pendant that enhances the adept's combat awareness.
system.gameEffect: Sustains the Combat Sense adept power, freeing power points.

system.description: A medical kit for field treatment of injuries.
system.gameEffect: Provides dice for First Aid tests. Rating determines dice pool.

system.description: Small, concealable communication device with skinlink capability.
A standard flashlight, infrared and low-light capable.
Fires a grapple with stealth line for climbing and traversal.
A sleek racing bike popular with couriers and speed-loving shadowrunners.
A well-connected fixer who operates out of a high-end bar in Downtown Seattle.
A street doc operating out of a clinic in Redmond. Reliable, discreet, no questions asked.
Nightwire's former martial arts and adept training master. Reclusive but fiercely loyal to his former student.
